moves.name: Lay Eggs
moves.notes: Always followed by Smash. Always used at the start of combat. This branch is only chosen while fewer than 3 other enemy allies are alive. The move summons 3 Tough Egg with Minion .

moves.name: Nutritional Paste
moves.notes: Always followed by Smash. If 3 other enemy allies are already alive, Ovicopter stops laying eggs and uses this move instead.

enemy.pattern_text: Shows this enemy's repeating move order. Lay Eggs will summon until there are 3 allies alive (no allies alive -> summons 3, 1 allies alive -> summons 2, etc)
